label: I q.20 a.2: God wills each creature its GOOD_4 in esse (CREATURE_WILLING_1)
interpretation: The corpus moves from the will causing a creature's esse to esse as a good willed to that creature, and glosses love as willing good to another. Reply 3 describes the love of irrational creatures as quasi-desire ordered to rational creatures and to God, and reserves friendship and benevolence in the proper sense for rational creatures. Reply 4 distinguishes loving a sinner in respect of existing nature from hating the same sinner in respect of fault.
attribution: The passage states that for each existing creature, its esse is itself a good and God wills that good to it, since God's will is the cause of things, which is the premise.
